workItem: Harden the trusted PR production-baseline auto-refresh so every successful main merge synchronization refreshes synchronized open PR baselines before the later verified production deployment refresh, without executing candidate code or weakening exact main/head governance binding.
workItemDE: Den vertrauenswürdigen PR-Produktions-Baseline-Auto-Refresh so härten, dass nach jeder erfolgreichen Main-Merge-Synchronisierung die Baselines synchronisierter offener PRs vor dem späteren verifizierten Production-Deploy-Refresh aktualisiert werden, ohne Kandidatencode auszuführen oder die exakte Main-/Head-Governance-Bindung abzuschwächen.
correlationInputs: PR #650 stale-baseline race observed after PR #649 merge
authorityGuard: No new ADR/ESS/AUTH/CTRL identity is created. The change only extends the existing trusted default-branch baseline orchestration. Candidate code remains data-only, immutable action SHAs remain pinned, fork/cross-repository PRs remain excluded, exact current-main/head binding remains fail-closed, and Human/CODEOWNER merge authority is unchanged.
releaseCondition: Release on Human merge, close, supersession or abandonment. PR creation remains exact-snapshot Human/Owner-gated; merge remains Human/CODEOWNER-only.
